AI-ops platform

⧉ Copy link ✎ Edit
Architecture 7 min read· Indexed 2 h ago from e2350b7
TL;DR An in-house incident responder: sre-agent receives alerts, reads cluster state through cluster-vision and past incidents through kb-vision, plans actions, and escalates to ticket-vision when a fix is unsafe.

The components

This homelab runs an in-house AI-ops stack: an autonomous incident responder that consumes alerts, reads cluster state and historical incidents, plans actions, and executes them. Everything is first-party; see ADR-0007.

ServiceRole
sre-agentAlert listener + LLM orchestrator
cluster-visionCluster state read API for the LLM
kb-visionPast incidents and runbooks (RAG)
